Flow.description: [IACRM-247 2026-06-25] Intégration mode Key Criteria : 3 branches Check_Evaluation_Mode (Key Criteria / Full Mode / Default Simplified) avec conditions CA + type + segment + Global_Primary_Service__c (Technical Services vs autres). Ajout Set_Mode_Key_Criteria, screen Critères Clés (Credit Score RO + CA RO + Billing Frequency + Target Margin → IssuerComment). Ajout GNG_Sectoral_Ref_Interest__c dans GNG_Business_Case_Screen_Simplifie. [IACRM-247 2026-06-24] Option A — Bifurcation avant Screen 2 : ajout New_Oppty_Approval_Request_Screen_Simplifie (6 info + 4 compliance scoring : Credit Score C1.1, Billing Frequency C1.2, Payment Method C1.3, Bank Guarantee C2.1), suppression GNG_Compliance_Screen_Simplifie et Route_Compliance_Screens, suppression Similar_references_at_Atalian__c de GNG_Business_Case_Screen (doublon Screen 2). [IACRM-247 2026-06-23] Auto-détection mode évaluation GNG : Check_Evaluation_Mode (CA≤600k€), Set_Mode_Simplified/Full, Route_Compliance_Screens, GNG_Compliance_Screen_Simplifie (4 critères), GNG_Business_Case_Screen_Simplifie (3 critères). Suppression GNG_Evaluation_Mode_Screen (sélection manuelle remplacée). [IACRM-247 2026-06-18] Nettoyage V2 de l'écran principal New_Oppty_Approval_Request_Screen : suppression des champs hors scoring V2 et hors layout OAR. Section Global Information : supprimé Operations_Lead__c, Customer_Sector (ESConnect_NACE_Label__c), Number_of_Sites__c, Certifications__c, Clearance_Authorization__c, FR_ContractType__c. Section Customer Data : supprimé Total_Open_Opps_Amount__c, Number_of_active_contract (Active_Contracts__c), Synergies_with_other_business_lines__c, Current_provider_satisfaction_level__c. Section Customer Relationship : supprimé Centralized_procurement_policy__c, Customer_relationship_quality__c. Section Financial Data : supprimé Contract_Duration_Months__c, Progress_Plan__c, Current_GM_if_rebid (Contract_Custom__r), Safeguard_Clause__c. Section Social Data : supprimé Social_Engineering__c, Social_Climate__c. Même nettoyage appliqué aux inputAssignments de Create_Opportunity_Approval_Request (15 assignments supprimés). Champs conservés : tous les critères GNG scoring V2 actifs. Historique antérieur : replace legacy fields // update Credit Score ESCONNECT (lastScore /10) + Account_Type_NEW__c. // ajouter les grands comptes dans le mode COMPLET + remove OneTrust fields from assignments // reorganize screen
